_comment: Expected values are DECISIONS, not guesses. Every case says why in `note`.
Twice while probing by hand I wrote an expectation that was simply wrong and only
noticed by reading output; a reviewed file is the fix for that.
`expect` is matched field-by-field: name only the fields the case is actually about.
`open_question: true` marks a case whose correct answer is a product decision nobody
has made yet. Those are reported but never fail the run.

cases.text: Purchase of AED 125.50 with card 1234 at SPINNEYS DUBAI MARINA
cases.note: The plain shape. If this breaks, something is badly wrong.

cases.text: AED 245.75 spent at SPINNEYS. Ref 88213. Balance AED 3,190.40
cases.note: Must pick the spend, not the larger balance and not the reference number.

cases.text: USD 42.10 (AED 154.62) spent at AMAZON.COM on card 4417
cases.note: Regression guard. Recorded 42.10 until 2026-09-03 - wrong by 3.7x on a shape UAE cards produce constantly. The billed amount is what leaves the account.

cases.text: Purchase USD 100.00 at APPLE.COM. Converted AED 367.25 incl 2.5% fee
cases.note: Same rule via different wording: 'converted' rather than brackets.

cases.text: USD 42.10 spent at AMAZON.COM on card 4417
cases.note: The counterpart guard: with no local amount stated, keep the foreign currency. The fix must not invent a conversion.

cases.text: Salary of AED 12,500.00 has been credited to your account 5678 on 01/09/2026
cases.note: Regression guard. Returned null and was silently discarded until 2026-09-03. Hisabak has an INCOME type and ships a template for this shape.

cases.text: Refund of AED 120.00 from NOON has been credited to your card 4417
cases.note: A credit with a real merchant. Direction is the category's job, not the parser's.

cases.text: Purchase of AED 89.00 at TALABAT-DXB-991 with card 1234
cases.note: The two brand fields must diverge. brand links the transaction; brand_text is what template synthesis replaces. Using brand for both baked '-DXB-' into learned rules.

cases.text: AED 1,255.00 has been debited at IKEA DUBAI using card 7788
cases.note: amount_text must stay verbatim including the separator - deriveAiSpans locates it literally.

cases.text: Your card was used for AED 400 at ADNOC STATION 42 today
cases.note: Whole-number amounts, and a merchant whose name ends in digits.

cases.text: تم خصم ٢٥٠٫٧٥ درهم من بطاقتك لدى كارفور
cases.note: Arabic with Arabic-Indic digits and an Arabic decimal separator. Nano's worst failure mode.

cases.text: Your OTP is 458213. Do not share it with anyone.
cases.note: Contains a number and arrives from a bank. A false positive here creates a junk transaction unprompted.

cases.text: Dear customer, your statement for August 2026 is ready in the app.
Your card 4417 was used at CARREFOUR. Check the app for details
cases.note: A real transaction with no amount. Better to return nothing than to invent one.
The note path: relative dates resolve against today. Only here - a bank alert must never invent a date.

cases.text: Your purchase of AED 3,600.00 at EMAX is split into 12 monthly payments of AED 300.00
cases.note: The purchase is what happened now; the instalment schedule is not a separate transaction.

cases.text: AED 50.00 cashback earned on your AED 500.00 purchase at NOON
cases.note: UNDECIDED. Record the 50 cashback (income) or the 500 purchase (expense, which likely already arrived as its own SMS)? Currently the cashback. Decide, then drop this flag.
